name: finding
description: A finding of the architecture model (#619): a candidate risk a fixed check raises. Its key is its kind, '/' and what the kind is about, such as snapshot-dependency/shop/artifact:com.acme:lib, with whitespace percent-encoded.

name: finding-raised
description: A fixed check raised the subject finding, of the kind the value names (#619): snapshot-dependency, dependency-drift, package-cycle, end-of-life, version-skew, shared-jwt-secret, unrouted-endpoint or readme-contradiction; or, raised by the injection screen with origin llm after derivation (ADR 0101), injection-suspected. Its key attributes are what the kind is about, so a skew between other versions is another claim; its lineage is the facts behind it. Whether it is new or gone follows from its validity.

rule.description: The rule that raised it: findings/ and its kind.

about.description: What it is about: a repository (repo: and its name), a service, library or module, a deployable unit, or the subject of the fact it wraps.

repo.description: For a dependency finding, the repository whose modules depend.

target.description: For a dependency finding, what they depend on.

versions.description: For a dependency finding, the versions, sorted: the unreleased ones, or every one in use.

packages.description: For a package cycle, its packages, sorted.

product.description: For an end of life, the runtime or framework.

version.description: For an end of life, the version in use, as the facts give it.

via.description: For an end of life, how the version is in use: a unit's technology, a module's dependency, or the Java release a module is compiled for.

module.description: For an end of life through a module, the module.

support.description: For an end of life, what the bundled table says: free support until a date, a line older than any it lists, or ended by a date at the latest.

line.description: For an end of life, the version's line in the table.

ends.description: For an end of life with a date, the date (ISO 8601). Whether support has ended is judged as of a document's date.

lines.description: For an injection-suspected finding, the flagged lines of the file, from-to.

quote.description: For an injection-suspected finding, the words the screen quoted from those lines.
